title: Nebula
description: Keep a small Mars base alive for seven sols: track the Sun, scrub dust off your solar array by hand, make oxygen, grow food and shelter from a solar particle event.

defaultCaptions.x: Nebula: keep a Mars base alive for seven sols. Scrub the dust off your solar panels by hand and get to shelter before the particle storm hits.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Nebula is a small Mars survival field lab. Learn the base, then keep it running for seven sols: scrub solar panels, balance oxygen and power, and shelter from radiation.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I've been polishing Nebula, a Three.js + Rapier Mars survival lab built on NASA-referenced data. You can now hand-scrub dusty solar panels.
defaultCaptions.discord: Nebula: Mars base survival. Scrub panels, make oxygen, survive the particle event.
